g.aria-label: Bae Ambua and Datu Mangoranda: either may be the sibling of Mampay; identity unresolved
g.title: Family account from a family informant: Bayango Gandamasir is a full first cousin of all children of Bae Ambua. Mampay may be a sibling of either Bae Ambua or Datu Mangoranda; which person is not yet known.

g.aria-label: Kararatan, children of Bae Ambua, and Zolaika: reported full first cousins of Bayango Gandamasir according to Alicasan
g.title: According to the Alicasan family account, Kararatan, the seven previously listed children of Bae Ambua, and Zolaika are full first cousins of Bayango Gandamasir. Zolaika remains the child of Datu Mangoranda and Sinar. Antao H. Aisa is shown beside her spouse Hadji Nor for context, not as another child. The shared ancestor and whether Mampay is a sibling of Ambua or Mangoranda remain unresolved.

path.title: Mampay may be a sibling of either Bae Ambua or Datu Mangoranda. This line connects to their shared group, not to one identified person. According to the family account; unresolved.

Mohamad Ali Dimaporo and Calanda Ginaronai are reported second cousins in the family account. Their shared ancestors and connecting ancestry are not yet identified. This refers to Mohamad Ali Dimaporo (chart-132), not the earlier Sultan Dimaporo (chart-126).
Family informant: Tuan sa Magonaya → Gandamasir. Family account.
Kararatan is reported as another child in the Ambua–Mangoranda family and sibling of Tantowaraga, according to Alicasan. Parentage remains a family-account claim.
Kararatan became Punda’s spouse, according to Alicasan.
Bayango Gandamasir and this family group: full first cousins according to Alicasan. This is a reported cousin relationship, not a parent–child link.
The shared partnership line between Kararatan and Punda branches to their child Ebra, according to the Alicasan account.

g.aria-label: Ginaronai · Alicasan account
g.title: Ginaronai ang ama ni Calanda Ginaronai ayon kay Alicasan.

Bayango Gandamasir, pangalan sa legal na dokumento. Est. c. 1915–1925. Anak nina Mampay at Gandamasir at buong pinsan nina Sultan Hadji Nor at Tantowaraga ayon kay Alicasan. According to Alicasan, November 9, 2026, Bayango Gandamasir and Calanda Ginaronai are second cousins through the Digadong family. Their common ancestor and intervening ancestry have not yet been identified; this is a reported family relationship, not a calculated or independently verified kinship result.

g.aria-label: Calanda Ginaronai · Alicasan account
g.title: Calanda Ginaronai, baybay sa legal na dokumento. Isinusulat ding Calanda Guinaronai. Tinatayang ipinanganak c. 1905–1930, batay sa kapanganakan ng anak na si Alicasan noong 1949. Asawa ni Bayango. According to Alicasan Calanda, Calanda Ginaronai travelled to Manila to sell peanuts. The date, route, vessel and length of stay are not yet known. This oral account is open for research in passenger lists, port or shipping records and other relevant archives; no matching record has yet been identified. According to Alicasan, November 9, 2026, Bayango Gandamasir and Calanda Ginaronai are second cousins through the Digadong family. Their common ancestor and intervening ancestry have not yet been identified; this is a reported family relationship, not a calculated or independently verified kinship result.

g.aria-label: Tabunawan · father of Usman Imam · sixth-generation descendant · Kawashima Midori
g.title: Provisional birth range c. 1883–1918: inferred solely for layout by subtracting assumed parental age 25–60 from Usman’s 1943 birth year. Not a recorded birth date or a statement by Kawashima; row alignment does not prove contemporaneity.

g.aria-label: Unknown mother of Usman Imam · from Bayang · Kawashima Midori
g.title: Provisional birth range c. 1898–1923: inferred solely for layout by subtracting assumed parental age 20–45 from Usman’s 1943 birth year. Not a recorded birth date or a statement by Kawashima; row alignment does not prove contemporaneity.

g.aria-label: Usman Imam Sheik Al-Aman · son of Tabunawan
g.title: Usman Imam Sheik Al-Aman. Full name listed in Journal of Sophia Asian Studies 22 (2004), pp. 173–195. Alignment with Alicasan is for diagram layout, not proof of the same generation.

g.aria-label: Mamadra · sibling of Usman Imam · half-brother of Ginaronai
g.title: Mamadra: sibling of Usman Imam and half-brother of Ginaronai, according to the family account. Placed on Usman’s row to show the sibling relationship; birth date and shared parents are not established.

g.aria-label: Tuan sa Magonaya · child of Hadji Said · father of Gandamasir · family account
g.title: According to the family account: Hadji Said → Tuan sa Magonaya → Gandamasir. Separate people; family-account connection.

g.aria-label: Kararatan · reported sibling of Tantowaraga, spouse of Punda and biological parent of Ebra · according to Alicasan
g.title: According to Alicasan: Kararatan is reported as a sibling of Tantowaraga, became Punda’s spouse, and is Ebra’s biological parent. This account differs from the earlier salsila attribution of Ebra to Tantowaraga; both accounts remain identified.

g.aria-label: Ebra, child of Punda and Kararatan according to Alicasan; identity with the salsila Ebra is unverified
g.title: Ebra, child of Punda and Kararatan. Reported full first cousin of Mohamad Ali Calanda and his siblings, according to the family account. Kept separate from the Ebra listed under Tantowaraga; whether those two records refer to the same person remains unverified.
